description: This file defines API routes for managing roles in a FastAPI application, including listing roles, retrieving a specific role by ID, and creating new roles with admin privileges.

methods.name: list_roles
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all roles, with optional authorization.

methods.name: get_role
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific role by ID, with optional authorization.

methods.name: create_role
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new role, restricted to admin users.
